title: zhfmt configuration
description:
Config file schema (`zhfmt.json` / `.zhfmt.json`); see module docs for
lookup order.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support (optional, ignored by zhfmt).

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude, relative to the walk root.

extensions.description: File extensions to process (without dot), replacing the defaults.

include.description:
Additional glob patterns to include (even if the extension does not
match), relative to the walk root.

jobs.description: Number of walker threads; 0 or absent means auto.

whitelist.description:
Character pairs between which no space is inserted; each entry is
exactly two characters (e.g. `"B站"` keeps `B站` unspaced).
